reviews.review: love this game so much bought it twice for my new pc from ps5

I should have done this a long time ago.
Don't play this for anything other than the story and the setting--which isn't a lot because they banked the replayability and total content off of the Operations and PVP mode (which both suffer from overwhelmingly poor design). Play Darktide if you are in it for the gameplay. Am I biased? Of course, I'm human (and I got over 1000 hours). But am I wrong? No, and yes. It's an opinion.

Does this game do some good? Yes!
-Beautiful visuals and animations (the executions, especially the newer ones with the Power Axe and against Chaos Spawns, make you feel like a real warrior. Some of them could use some work, though due to pacing and repetition). If you like Spacemarines or like looking at Spacemarines, here you are.

As for why I don't like this game:
This game as a whole can be described with the following word: "Cinemaslop." It pushes the slow-motion gimmick into almost, if not EVERY important interaction between you and the enemies/environment: parrying, dodging, gunstrikes, executions, removing random debris, and probably more I forgot from how mind numbing it is. The slow-motion is actually DETRIMENTAL to your gameplay because it does not slow time, it just slows your perception. Try parrying the three-hit combo from Raveners with a Balanced weapon and you may see what I am getting at (I am not saying it isn't possible to do so. It isn't particularly hard but it is annoying).
If there was no slow-motion I could legitimately consider changing my review to a disappointed "Yes". It is that egregious it is to me.

The core game mechanics are just bad (looking at you gunstrikes and parry window), the difficulty and a majority of the enemy design is poorly thought out. To top it all off the developers did not bother giving the player vital information needed for buildcrafting and the optimization of loadouts, like true damage numbers. Instead you get this make-believe "weapon data" GUI that oversells the weapon's true stats.

Most class and weapon perks are bad/niche or a throwaway point which means your builds will be very linear and lack variety.
Most melee weapons average around okay or just flat out subpar (the Knife is a great example of subpar) however most ranged weapons are DECENT or even really strong, credit where credit is due. The real issue for melee weapons versus ranged weapons, though, is that they are impacted the most by the enemies and their design.

The enemies of SM2 as a whole are poorly made or conflict with other features of the game and makes the fights either super unfun or a STUNLOCKFEST as they take turns when there is two or more against you after a singular mistake (You can find clips of people literally being unable to play the game until they die because of how many times they get stunned). It feels like the game was not made the concept of more than one boss being on the field at a time yet the developers did it anyways to make Siege mode more difficult.
Trash mobs (Hormagaunts and ESPECIALLY Tzaangors) are awful to fight in swarms because it devolves into parry spam or headshotting them at range. This is because melee attacks on their own are WEAK and will get you KILLED when in a swarm.

The difficulty scaling is absurd due to a lack of balance for both sides, like how the enemies get 4x HP on anything above Substantial and 5x HP for bosses on Absolute (it can spawn two field bosses so you have to slog through that twice) while the player goes down to 0.5x HP and 0.25x Armor. On higher difficulties they ENRAGE, which means they HEAL TO MAX, deal MORE DAMAGE, and have HYPER ARMOR. You can probably start to see a problem emerge.
Let's not even bother mentioning how bad it gets with Enraged Devourer Warriors. Those who know, will know.

I probably forgot a lot of my gripes with the game and I have a lot more to say but it is mostly redundant and full of resentment and anger. You can find and proof most if not all of the information above on the SM2 wiki and through mods.

TLDR
I do not like this game and I believe they did a bad job with many designs and features. 200 Hours in and it has been disappointing every step of the way (Strategems has only highlighted these problems further).
Yes, it's a good fps horror game. It's kinda like deadspace style of fps, where it's just lots of OP fun even on hardest difficulty.

Glorious cooperative third person action with a decent amount of replay value these days with the cooperative missions, PVP modes and wave based survival mode.  If you enjoyed Space Marine 1 back in the day then this is more of the same with Tyranids and Thousand Suns to shoot and crush.  

Set piece moments are great, the cooperative mode is tons of fun and everything feels weighty and powerful like Space Marines should.  The team are still actively supporting the game with year 2 of post launch content (all free) with the only paid DLC being cosmetic items like class specific armours for PVE or visual customisation items.  

Overall it's solid if your rig can run it comfortably.
